put pressure on: Parents should not put pressure on their children to get perfect grades in every subject.
父母不應該對孩子施壓，要求他們每一科都拿滿分。
put an end to: The new law is meant to put an end to the use of plastic straws in restaurants.
這項新法律的目的是終結餐廳使用塑膠吸管。
put forward a proposal: At the class meeting, Lisa decided to put forward a proposal to hold a charity sale.
在班會上，莉莎決定提出舉辦義賣的提案。
put up with: I can't put up with the noise from my neighbor's loud music every night any longer.
我再也無法忍受鄰居每晚大聲放音樂的噪音了。
put aside differences: The two leaders agreed to put aside differences and work together to fight the disease.
兩位領袖同意擱置分歧，攜手對抗這種疾病。
put off: We had to put off the school picnic until next Sunday because of the heavy rain.
因為下大雨，我們只好把校外野餐延後到下週日。
put down roots: After moving from city to city for years, my parents finally want to put down roots in a quiet town.
在城市間搬來搬去好幾年後，我爸媽終於想在一個安靜的小鎮落地生根。
put in effort: If you put in effort every day, your English will improve faster than you expect.
如果你每天付出努力，你的英文會進步得比你預期的還快。
puzzle over a problem: The detective sat by the window to puzzle over a problem that seemed to have no answer at all.
那名偵探坐在窗邊苦思一個似乎完全沒有答案的問題。
be puzzled by: Many students seemed to be puzzled by the confusing instructions and didn't know what to do next.
許多學生似乎對那些令人混淆的指示感到困惑，不知道接下來該做什麼。
puzzle out the answer: It took me almost an hour to puzzle out the answer to the last math question on the test.
我花了將近一個小時才想出考卷上最後一題數學的答案。
a puzzling result: The scientists got a puzzling result that nobody in the lab could explain, so they did the test again.
科學家們得到一個令人費解的結果，實驗室裡沒人能解釋，所以他們又做了一次實驗。
qualify for the final: Our team needs to win just one more game to qualify for the final next month.
我們的隊伍只要再贏一場比賽，就能晉級下個月的決賽。
qualify as a doctor: After seven years of medical school and hospital training, my cousin will finally qualify as a doctor.
經過七年的醫學院課程和醫院訓練，我表哥終於將取得醫師資格。
qualify a statement: The minister had to qualify his statement, adding that the tax cut was only for low-income families.
部長必須對他的說法加以限定，補充說減稅只適用於低收入家庭。
qualify for a discount: Students who show their ID cards at the museum qualify for a discount on the entrance fee.
在博物館出示學生證的學生符合門票折扣資格。
qualify for a loan: Because he had a steady job and no debts, he was able to qualify for a loan from the bank.
因為他有穩定的工作又沒有負債，所以他符合銀行的貸款資格。
quarrel over money: The two brothers often quarrel over money, especially after their father left them his house.
這兩兄弟常常為錢吵架，尤其是在父親把房子留給他們之後。
quarrel with a decision: Few players dared to quarrel with a decision made by the strict referee during the game.
比賽中很少有球員敢對那位嚴格裁判的決定有異議。
pick a quarrel: When Tom is in a bad mood, he will pick a quarrel with anyone over the smallest thing.
湯姆心情不好時，會為了一點小事就找任何人吵架。
question one's motives: When the rich man suddenly offered to help, many villagers began to question his motives behind the gift.
那個有錢人突然提議幫忙時，許多村民開始質疑這份禮物背後的動機。
question a suspect: The police officers took several hours to question a suspect about where he was on the night of the robbery.
警察花了好幾個小時訊問嫌犯搶案當晚他人在哪裡。
question the decision: Many fans began to question the decision to sell the team's best player to a rival club.
許多球迷開始質疑把球隊最佳球員賣給對手球會的決定。
beyond question: Her talent for music is beyond question; she won first prize in every contest she entered.
她的音樂天分無庸置疑；她參加的每場比賽都得了第一名。
call into question: The new evidence may call into question everything the police believed about the case.
這項新證據可能會使人懷疑警方對此案所相信的一切。
quit one's job: Tired of working late every night, she decided to quit her job and travel around Europe.
厭倦了每晚加班，她決定辭職去歐洲旅行。
quit smoking: My grandfather finally decided to quit smoking after the doctor warned him about his weak lungs.
醫生警告我爺爺他的肺很虛弱之後，他終於決定戒菸。
quit while you're ahead: You've already won three games in a row, so maybe you should quit while you're ahead and go home.
你已經連贏三場了，所以也許你應該見好就收，回家去吧。
quit complaining: Please quit complaining about the homework and just start doing it, or you'll never finish tonight.
請別再抱怨作業了，快點開始寫，不然你今晚永遠寫不完。
